newsitem.title: USA: S. Carolina jobless rate unchanged in November.
newsitem.headline: S. Carolina jobless rate unchanged in November.

text.p: South Carolina's unemployment rate was 6.1 percent for November, unchanged from October and up from 5.3 percent a year ago, the state Employment Security Commission said Friday.
The hiring of temporary pollworkers for the November general elections helped push total nonfarm employment up by 11,900 to 1.7 million in November.
Trade showed seasonal gains while services reported normal tourism-related reductions. Manufacturing companies cut payrolls by 1,000.

"With the Christmas shopping season, we are hopeful that the unemployment rate will be affected positively in December," said commission Executive Director Joel Cassidy. "However it should be noted that seasonal employment reductions in other ara of the economy such as tourism will likely temper these gains."
Beaufort County had South Carolina's lowest unemployment rate for November, 3 percent, and Williamsburg County had the highest, 20 percent.
